data.standardized_narrative: Unable to reliably extract gross claims outstanding or a gross prior-year reserve movement from the supplied scanned images. The report images are low resolution/rotated, and the Balance Sheet / Technical Provisions movement note containing the authoritative gross figures could not be unambiguously read. Gross written premium is visible in the managing agent text but detailed reserve movements, causation and classbyclass numeric movements could not be reliably determined from the images provided.
data.data_quality_notes: PDF contained scanned images only; text is rotated and low-resolution in places. I could identify total gross written premium (113,399 shown in the report - interpreted as GBP 113,399,000 -> 113.399m) but could not unambiguously read the Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' gross prior-year (2015) figure or any 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' GROSS column. No authoritative gross prior-year movement could be found with confidence in the images provided. Recommend providing a higher-resolution or OCR-readable copy of the relevant pages (Balance Sheet / Technical provisions note / Movement in prior year claims outstanding / Claims development table) for precise extraction.
